description: This file implements the GatewayDiscovery class, which handles discovery of network gateways using mDNS, DNS unicast, and other network mechanisms in an Android environment. It manages local and wide-area discovery, resolves services, and maintains a list of discovered gateways.

classes.name: GatewayDiscovery
classes.description: Main class responsible for discovering and managing gateway endpoints via multicast DNS, DNS unicast, and other network protocols.

methods.name: startLocalDiscovery
methods.description: Initiates local network service discovery using Android's NsdManager.

methods.name: startUnicastDiscovery
methods.description: Begins wide-area DNS unicast discovery in a background coroutine loop.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves a discovered network service into a GatewayEndpoint object and updates internal mappings.

methods.name: publish
methods.description: Updates the observable list of gateways and status text based on current discoveries.

methods.name: buildStatusText
methods.description: Constructs status message summarizing current discovery state.
